nav.label: Last published total-return reference per token, not a live equity price. It already includes dividends and splits.

staleness.method: v1: threshold = max(2 × the feed's p99 in-session gap between official rounds, 30 min). Open session: stale if no round for longer than the threshold since the later of the last round and today's open. Otherwise: expected_closed if the last round is no older than the threshold before the last session close, else unexpectedly_stale.
